dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Munchkin is on the at-risk list due to behavior concerns in his previous home. In the prior home, Munchkin was reported to have two incidents of growling and lunging toward her adopter's face while resting in separate areas of the home. Both incidents occurred without an identifiable trigger, and no physical contact was made. The adopter reported that Munchkin gave a low growl without baring her teeth, and neither incident escalated. Munchkin in the care center has been social with staff and volunteers but in kennel has also began to lunge, hard bark and bare teeth when people approach his kennel. Medically, Munchkin is apparently healthy.

Munchkin came into the care center after recently being adopted and then returned due to her behavioral concerns. Munchkin was returned after two reported incidents of growling and lunging toward the adopter's face within a short period of time, occurring while the adopter was resting in bed and later sitting on a couch. No identifiable triggers were reported, and no injuries occurred. The adopter described Munchkin as friendly and well-behaved otherwise. Munchkin is available for rescue through one of our new hope partners.

A volunteer writes: Munchkin surprises me by being 62lbs even though her name implies something smaller. Her face looks the part though, pouty and perfect, the tiniest row of ever present teeth showing. While reserved, she was friendly and I imagined she'd get adopted sooner rather than later.

In the meantime she went on a boroughbreak where she got to remember what it was like to be a pet again. She went to a pet store and picked out a toy, rolled in a park, chewed and watched the world go by in peace and quiet.

While Munchkin was briefly adopted, for just a day, she is now available via a rescue only in order to set her up to be supported and successful in her next home.
dog.name: Munchkin
